title: Bound Site runtime listener connection setup and subscription readiness
implementation: Added a five-second linked budget for PostgreSQL listener OpenAsync and LISTEN subscription setup.
Translated budget-only connection setup cancellation to retryable TimeoutException.
Moved connected status after LISTEN succeeds so operator diagnostics do not report a half-subscribed listener as connected.
